pairs.l: 1 — is put off at the thought of getting wet?
2 — enjoys the feeling of being in control?
3 — thinks their hobby is good value for money?
4 — finds the sense of danger uplifting?
6 — said that conditions might change quickly?
7 — prefers being able to spend time alone?
8 — began practising their activity by chance?
9 — finds tranquility in the predictability of the experience?
10 — enjoys the social opportunities their activity offers?
11 — worries about the amount of time they spend practising their hobby?
12 — has a predetermined schedule that they always follow?

r1.exp: 1=C (Cameron: 'apart from going through SUBMERGED PASSAGES — I CAN'T STAND THAT'). 2=E (Elijah: 'your MAP-READING SKILLS mean you have the ability to MASTER THE SITUATION, and I RELISH that'). 3=F (Fiona: 'not cheap; however, THE EXPERIENCE MORE THAN RECOMPENSES THE EXPENDITURE'). 4=D (Desirée: 'every sense is heightened; afterwards, I'm IN SUCH A BETTER PLACE' = danger uplifting). 5=B (Bernice: 'I'm really NOT INTO MEASURING MYSELF AGAINST OTHERS'). 6=C (Cameron: 'any FALSE SENSE OF SECURITY COULD BE DASHED IN THE BLINK OF AN EYE'). 7=A (Ali: 'I find it the PERFECT CONTRAST TO CONSTANT SOCIAL INTERACTION'). 8=D (Desirée: 'I JUST STUMBLED UPON IT'). 9=F (Fiona: 'it's ALWAYS just you in the air, as free as a bird, and that is INVARIABLY SOOTHING' = predictable + tranquil). 10=E (Elijah: 'I truly appreciate the added NETWORKING BENEFITS'). 11=D (Desirée: 'I'm ALWAYS STRESSING ABOUT WHETHER THERE'LL BE TIME to fit in some canoeing'). 12=B (Bernice: 'I DON'T VARY FROM THE SAME ROUTE, as that way I can time myself better').

r13.exp: 'Stimuli PREVIOUSLY UNFAMILIAR... GENUINELY MOMENTOUS... like a big long HUG' — sve sugerira iskustvo koje nije bilo predvidivo ni svakodnevno = D.

r14.exp: 'READ BETWEEN THE LINES and look BEYOND THE ESSENCE OF THE ACTUAL WORDS' = vidjeti širu sliku, ne samo slijediti upute doslovno = B.

r15.exp: 'A ramen researcher and scholar DATES the birth of ramen to the establishment of RAI-RAI KEN in Tokyo in 1910' = povjesničar/istraživač povezuje pojavu ramena s osnivanjem tog restorana = D.

r16.exp: 'THE HIGHLIGHT of the experience is LEARNING HOW TO STRETCH, KNEAD, CUT AND TASTE HOMEMADE RAMEN NOODLES' = stjecanje vještine izrade rezanci = A.

r17.exp: 'Draws a parallel between one's approaches to CUISINE AND TO EXISTENCE' = film o odnosu hrane i života = D.

r18.exp: 'CONSCIOUS OF YOUR ABILITIES... can ASSESS YOUR ACHIEVEMENTS POSITIVELY' = biti svjestan samoga sebe = self-aware = C.

r19.exp: 'Feelings of anxiety... are entirely NORMAL EXPERIENCES. (19)____. ENGAGING IN DECISION-MAKING plays a crucial role in fostering self-confidence.' → F: WE HANDLE THESE EMOTIONS by simply ACKNOWLEDGING THEIR PRESENCE.

r20.exp: 'Ancestors had a good chance of survival in a FAMILIAR ENVIRONMENT. (20)____. It is a MISTAKE to view this uncertainty as anything more than a COMMON OCCURRENCE.' → A: Being hesitant would often bring the risk of RUNNING OUT OF FOOD OR BECOMING FOOD THEMSELVES.

r21.exp: 'Obtaining CONFIRMATION is one of the most common methods. (21)____. THEREBY, we counteract crippling anxiety since WE SHIFT AWAY from ourselves a significant part of the responsibility.' → C: WE WANT TO VERIFY THAT WE HAVE MADE THE RIGHT DECISION.

r22.exp: 'Initially, this move might CALM US DOWN. (22)____. We send ourselves an UNDERMINING MESSAGE that we are INCAPABLE AND DEPENDENT.' → D: SOONER OR LATER, HOWEVER, WE BECOME EVEN MORE APPREHENSIVE AND LESS SELF-CONFIDENT.

r23.exp: 'People dread mistakes because they might have been unfairly punished... strived to be flawless. (23)____. Undoubtedly, most mistakes only lead to MINOR DISCOMFORTS OR LEARNING OPPORTUNITIES.' → H: WHATEVER THE REASON, the MAIN CULPRIT of such fear is a LACK OF KNOWLEDGE ABOUT THE REAL CONSEQUENCES.

r24.exp: 'Not all things are under our control. (24)____. In reality, by OBSESSING OVER THEM, WE UNDERMINE OUR SELF-CONFIDENCE.' → G: CONSTANT THINKING AND IMMENSE WORRY ABOUT THEM MIGHT CREATE AN ILLUSION OF COMMAND.

r25.exp: 'Drawings Alan HAD COMPLETED by the age of 12' — past perfect za radnju završenu prije drugog prošlog trenutka ('said that... were unique').

r26.exp: 'Can be ACQUIRED later in childhood' — 'acquire' = steći (o sposobnostima, osobinama); fiksna kolokacija.

r27.exp: 'HOWEVER, no one knows why or how savant abilities emerge' — kontrast prema prethodnoj rečenici koja tvrdi da su uvijek praćene prodigious memory = A.

r28.exp: 'Talent seems to EMBODY timeless beauty and outstanding composition' — 'embody' = utjeloviti, oličiti (nešto apstraktno).

r29.exp: 'Amazed by the beauty of his work, WHICH gives them an insight' — 'which' za nerestiktivnu relativnu rečenicu (refers to entire preceding clause).

r30.exp: 'To establish himself as an EMINENT artist' — 'eminent' = istaknut, ugledni. 'Imminent' = koji će uskoro nastupiti; 'eloquent' = rječit; 'indifferent' = ravnodušan.

r31.exp: 'With a view to SPARKING children's creativity' — 'with a view to' + gerund (-ing forma).

r32.exp: 'Explore a VARIETY of popular artistic projects' — fiksna kolokacija: a variety of = niz, razne vrste.

r33.exp: 'Treat myself TO an ice cream' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: treat oneself to = priuštiti si nešto.

r34.exp: 'Waist began to fill OUT' — frazalni glagol: fill out = proširiti se, popuniti se (o tijelu).

r35.exp: 'They HAVE encouraged me to end my bad habits' — present perfect za prošlo djelovanje s posljedicama u sadašnjosti.

r36.exp: 'Get WITH the programme!' — idiom: get with the programme = uključiti se, ići u korak (s programom/planom).

r37.exp: 'Working ON my physique' — frazalni glagol: work on = raditi na (poboljšanju nečega).

r38.exp: 'Jayden, who ASSURED me that hard work would yield results' — 'assure someone (that)' = uvjeriti, jamčiti nekome.

r39.exp: 'If I only HAD the will to keep with the schedule' — second conditional (if + past simple) za nešto što je tada bila sumnja.

r40.exp: 'They have ENSURED that I do not have to forgo the opportunity' — 'ensure (that)' = osigurati, pobrinuti se za to (da nešto bude).
